title: International Museum of Surgical Science

services.name: Schedule a Tour
services.desc: This building - 1524 North Lake Shore Drive - was built as a wedding present to Eleanor Robinson Countiss in 1917. The house was designed to resemble “Le Petit Trianon,” a French chateau that is best known as the extravagant retreat house of Marie Antoinette. The Countiss family was the sole owner of the building until Dr. Max Thorek and the International College of Surgeons acquired it. After several years of renovating the building and forming the Museum collection, the Museum opened its doors to the public in 1954.Much of the flooring and walls on the first and second floors are original to the house. Please treat the building respectfully, but also feel free to explore at your leisure!
